newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Commission initially clears Powerco/Egmont merger.
newsitem.headline: Commission initially clears Powerco/Egmont merger.

text.p: The New Zealand Commerce Commission on Friday said in its draft determination that it did not oppose the proposal of Powerco Ltd to buy all of Egmont Electricity.
Powerco is the New Plymouth and Wanganui-based natural gas and electricity supplier and Egmont supplies electricity in South Taranaki.

Chairman Alan Bollard said the merger would give rise to a dominant position in the market for the supply of natural gas and electrictiy to small consumers in the Hawera area but the preliminary view was that the benefits of the merger would outweigh detriments.
The combined entity would benefit from reduced costs and greater profitability and customers would get improved service.
Affected parties could still make submissions to the commission and a final decision would be made on July 31.
